## Client

```rust
let client = grow_zipkin::ZipkinClient::new(grow_zipkin::ZipkinConfig::from_env()?)?;
client.close().await;
```

Errors: `grow_zipkin::Error` with `code()` (`ErrorCode::NotFound`, …). Credentials are `Secret`.
